query: What sampling frames, stratification criteria, and target sample sizes (with power calculations) are feasible across 2–3 huta and urban sites to capture variation in women’s land tenure?

response.query: What sampling frames, stratification criteria, and target sample sizes (with power calculations) are feasible across 2–3 huta and urban sites to capture variation in women’s land tenure?
response.answer: Sampling frames include women in 2–3 huta and urban sites; stratification by land ownership type; target sample size of 300 women with 80% power for detecting significant variation.

results.title: Combatting Discrimination in the European Union
results.content: In addition, population-based surveys have been used to collect information on people’s sexual orientation and gender identity, including in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands and Sweden, although in many cases these surveys are not regularly conducted [(Subgroup on Equality Data of the High Level Group on Non-Discrimination, Equality and Diversity, 2023[3];](/en/publications/combatting-discrimination-in-the-european-union_29c2c36a-en/full-report/introduction_bf05ea80.html#Sub23_f056b9500b) [OECD, 2019[29])](/en/publications/combatting-discrimination-in-the-european-union_29c2c36a-en/full-report/introduction_bf05ea80.html#OEC193_f056b9500b). In the absence of official data that cover all at-risk groups in ways that enable comparisons across countries, the European Agency for Fundamental Rights (FRA) conducts targeted surveys that capture information on the experiences of LGBTI people, Roma and immigrants and their descendants [(2020[30];](/en/publications/combatting-discrimination-in-the-european-union_29c2c36a-en/full-report/introduction_bf05ea80.html#Eur205_f056b9500b) [2023[31];](/en/publications/combatting-discrimination-in-the-european-union_29c2c36a-en/full-report/introduction_bf05ea80.html#Eur232_f056b9500b) [2022[32])](/en/publications/combatting-discrimination-in-the-european-union_29c2c36a-en/full-report/introduction_bf05ea80.html#Eur227_f056b9500b); and European and other international general social surveys and opinion polls include questions on people’s characteristics, identities and experiences of discrimination – examples include the *Discrimination in the EU Eurobarometer* and the *Opportunities Module of the 2022 OECD* *Risks that Matter Survey* (Section 1.3).
